body.message:
We understand that the monthly rates for September and October are different. However, a full monthly booking is not possible in this case anyway, as the apartment is only available from 28th September until 23rd October.

We are offering to book the entire available period of 25 nights, which means the apartment would be continuously occupied until the next booking, without any gaps.

Considering the current rental market in Dubai and the large number of comparable properties currently available, we believe this should also be taken into consideration. We do have several other options, but we like this apartment and would be happy to proceed if we can agree on a reasonable rate.

We would therefore appreciate it if the owner could reconsider our AED 20,000 all-inclusive offer. If this is not acceptable, please ask the owner to provide their best possible all-inclusive rate for the entire available period.

We are ready to proceed immediately if we can agree on the price.
